title: Job Titles in India: Designation Hierarchy in Companies, IT, Banks and Government
seoTitle: Job Titles in India: Designation Hierarchy Explained
seoDescription: Job titles in India follow four systems: corporate ladders, IT grades, bank officer scales and government Pay Levels. See each hierarchy with tables.
excerpt: Side-by-side tables of the corporate ladder, TCS and Infosys grades, public sector bank scales I–VII and central government Pay Levels 1–18, plus what your title means legally and how to write it on a resume.
